The Cleaner — founding Elite member and former AEW World Champion.

How Kenny Omega connects

  • Faction: The Elite — Kenny Omega is a founding member of The Elite.
  • Item: AEW World Championship — Kenny Omega held the AEW World Championship at AEW's first peak.
  • Character: Hangman Adam Page — Hangman's world-title story turned on Kenny Omega.

What is Kenny Omega?

Kenny Omega is a founding Elite wrestler whose AEW World Championship reign, Hidden Blade, and partnerships with the Young Bucks and the Good Brothers defined the company's first peak.

Key threads lead to The Elite, AEW World Championship and Hangman Adam Page.
